title: One- and two- family dwellings.
officialText:
Floor furnace enclosures shall be constructed of noncombustible materials with a fire-
resistance rating of at least 1 hour. Means shall be provided for supporting the furnace when the grille is removed. Clearances
shall be provided as per NFPA 54.
SECTION MC 911
DUCT FURNACES
